empty.message: Add blood group, allergies, and ICE contacts for first responders.

edit.title: Edit emergency profile
edit.hint: Saved locally first. Sync happens in the background when you are online.
edit.contactRequired: Name, phone, and relationship are required
edit.contactDuplicate: That contact is already on your list

qr.title: Emergency QR
qr.emptyMessage: Create a profile before generating a QR code.
qr.subtitle: First responders can scan for critical details when you cannot speak.
qr.previewHint: QR rendering will use an Edge Function or on-device encoder in a follow-up.

lock.title: Emergency card
lock.help: Show this card if you cannot speak for yourself.
lock.widgetIos: Add the CareMate “Emergency Info” widget to your Lock Screen (long-press Lock Screen → Customize → Add Widget).
lock.widgetAndroid: Add the CareMate “Emergency Info” widget to your Home Screen (long-press home → Widgets).
lock.minimalFields: Minimal fields shown: name, blood group, genotype, allergies, and your first ICE contact.
lock.noProfileMessage: Open CareMate, create an Emergency Health Profile, and enable lock-screen visibility.
lock.footnoteIos: Add the CareMate Emergency Info widget to your Lock Screen for glanceable access when the device is locked.
lock.footnoteAndroid: Add the CareMate Emergency Info widget to your Home Screen. On Android, emergency responders can also open this card from the widget.
